title: Door was locked at Pakistan hospital where fire killed 14 babies, witnesses say
description: A hospital official told the BBC that the door to the ward was not locked, but manned with security guards, to protect the babies.

title: Pakistan: At least 14 newborns die in hospital fire
description: Devasted parents gathered outside a hospital in Islamabad, Pakistan, on Wednesday after a fire tore through a mother-and-baby ward, killing at least 14 newborns. Witnesses described chaotic and harrowing scenes, including intense smoke and broken glass, while local media blamed the tragedy on a faulty air conditioning system.

title: Ukrainian air attacks kill three in Russia as Kyiv steps up drone campaign
description: Attacks spark fires at Lukoils NORSI refinery and a Wildberries hub as Kyiv claims 16 targets hit across Russia.

title: Photos: Thousands join Spain’s La Tomatina festival for epic tomato battle
description: Over 20,000 participants hurled 165 tonnes of tomatoes in Buñols streets during Spains famed La Tomatina festival.

title: At least 14 babies die in Pakistan hospital fire
description: The fire broke out in an air conditioning unit at the mother and child unit in one of Islamabad's main hospitals.
